up: List distinct compounds that are associated with the document having ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3886941. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL ID, its preferred name (from the molecule dictionary), and its canonical SMILES. Do not add any extra filters.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3886941';
